name: Stop sign
setup: Wandegeya junction. A STOP sign, and a matatu coming fast from the right.
rule: At a STOP sign you must come to a complete halt at the line, look both ways, and only go when it is clear. Slowing down is not stopping.

options.text: Stop completely, look both ways, then go
options.outcome: You wait, the matatu roars past, and you cross safely.

options.text: Slow down and roll through
options.outcome: The matatu clips your back wheel and you skid. A traffic officer writes you a fine.

options.text: Speed up and beat the matatu
options.outcome: You cut across its path. It brakes hard, you go down, and the police arrive.

name: Give way sign
setup: Joining Jinja Road from a side street. GIVE WAY sign. The main road is thick with traffic.
rule: GIVE WAY means traffic on the main road has priority. Be ready to stop and only go when there is a safe gap.

options.text: Slow down and wait for a safe gap
options.outcome: You wait a few seconds, then slot in safely.

options.text: Push in. They will brake
options.outcome: A truck cannot stop in time. You are thrown off your bike.

options.text: Hoot and go
options.outcome: Hooting does not give you priority. A car swerves and clips you.

name: Red traffic light
setup: Red light on Kampala Road. The junction looks empty.
rule: Red means stop behind the line. Riding through red lights is one of the leading causes of boda crashes.

options.text: Stop behind the line and wait for green
options.outcome: Green comes. You go, and nobody is hurt.

options.text: Slip through. Nothing is coming
options.outcome: A car on green hits your front wheel. A police officer saw everything.

options.text: Stop on the zebra crossing, past the line
options.outcome: Pedestrians squeeze around you. The officer fines you for blocking the crossing.

name: Pedestrian crossing
setup: A mother and two children step onto the zebra crossing at Nakasero.
rule: Pedestrians on a zebra crossing have priority. Slow down, stop, and wait until they are across.

options.text: Slow down and stop for them
options.outcome: They cross safely. The mother nods at you.

options.text: Hoot and swerve around them
options.outcome: A child stumbles back and you clip her. She is taken to hospital and you are arrested.

options.text: Speed up to pass before they cross
options.outcome: You hit the mother. You are arrested at the scene.

name: School children ahead
setup: School is out. Children pour onto the road near Kabalagala.
rule: Near schools, children are unpredictable. Slow down, watch the verges, and be ready to stop.

options.text: Slow right down and be ready to stop
options.outcome: You crawl through. A boy dashes out and you stop in time.

options.text: Keep your speed. They are on the other side
options.outcome: A child runs across. You brake too late and hit him. You are arrested.

options.text: Hoot at them to clear the road
options.outcome: The children scatter and one runs into your path. You fall.

name: Speed limit 50
setup: A 50 sign in the built-up area. A friend revs beside you: "Race me!"
rule: A speed limit sign is a maximum, not a target. Ride slower when the road is busy or wet.

options.text: Stay at or below 50 km/h
options.outcome: He races off. You stay safe and your fare pays you well.

options.text: Race him at 80
options.outcome: You hit a pothole at speed and lose control.

options.text: Go 65. Just a little over
options.outcome: A police speed check waves you down. You brake late and wobble.

name: No overtaking
setup: A slow truck ahead. A NO OVERTAKING sign. The road looks clear.
rule: Do not overtake where a sign or a solid centre line says no. You cannot see what is coming round the bend.

options.text: Stay behind the truck
options.outcome: You wait. A matatu comes round the bend, right where you would have been.

options.text: Overtake. It looks clear enough
options.outcome: A matatu appears round the bend, head-on.

options.text: Overtake on the left, on the verge
options.outcome: You clip a pedestrian's bag and slide on the gravel.

name: No entry
setup: Kampala Road is jammed. The one-way street beside you is empty, with a NO ENTRY sign.
rule: NO ENTRY means vehicles must not enter from this side. Riding against traffic is a leading cause of boda crashes.

options.text: Stay in the jam, or take the long way round
options.outcome: It takes longer, but you arrive in one piece.

options.text: Ride the wrong way. Just 100 metres
options.outcome: A taxi comes round the corner straight at you. Police catch you.

options.text: Wait until nobody is watching, then go
options.outcome: Someone is always watching. A car swerves and you go down.

name: Traffic officer
setup: A traffic officer steps out and raises a hand. You are running late for a fare.
rule: Always obey a traffic officer's signal. It overrides signs and lights.

options.text: Stop, greet, and show your permit
options.outcome: He checks your papers and waves you on.

options.text: Ride on. You will explain later
options.outcome: The officer radios ahead. You are arrested at the next junction.

options.text: Turn into a side street to avoid him
options.outcome: He follows. You are fined and your bike is held.

name: Emergency vehicle
setup: A siren behind you on Entebbe Road.
rule: Give way to emergency vehicles. Move to the left and stop until they pass.

options.text: Move to the left and stop until it passes
options.outcome: It races past. Someone gets to hospital faster.

options.text: Speed up to stay ahead of it
options.outcome: You block the ambulance. The driver has to force past you.

options.text: Hold your lane. You have priority
options.outcome: You do not. The ambulance forces you off the road.

name: Helmets
setup: Your passenger has no helmet. She says it is only five minutes away.
rule: Rider and passenger must both wear a helmet, fastened. A helmet that is not fastened is as dangerous as none.

options.text: No helmet, no ride. Give her your spare
options.outcome: She wears it. You both ride safely.

options.text: Fine, five minutes only
options.outcome: A pothole throws her onto the road. She is badly hurt and the police blame you.

options.text: Let her hold your helmet in her hands
options.outcome: A checkpoint stops you. A helmet in the hand protects nobody.

name: One passenger
setup: Three people want to ride with you and offer UGX 15,000 in total.
rule: One passenger at most, sitting astride and facing forward. An overloaded bike cannot balance or brake.

options.text: One passenger only. Turn down the rest
options.outcome: You lose the big fare, but keep your bike stable.

options.text: Take all three. It is a big fare
options.outcome: The bike is unbalanced and you fall at the first corner.

options.text: Take two. Only a short distance
options.outcome: The bike wobbles and drags on the brakes. Police fine you.

name: Phone while riding
setup: Your phone rings. It is a big client.
rule: Never use a phone while riding. Stop safely, then call back.

options.text: Let it ring. Call back when you stop
options.outcome: You call back ten minutes later and still get the job.

options.text: Answer it. One hand is fine
options.outcome: You wobble, drift toward a pedestrian, and fall.

options.text: Tuck the phone under your helmet and talk
options.outcome: You cannot hear the horn behind you. A boda clips you.

name: Alcohol
setup: A friend at the stage offers you a beer before your next fare.
rule: Never ride after drinking. Alcohol slows your reactions and blurs your judgement.

options.text: No. Water only
options.outcome: Your friend laughs. You ride home with a clear head.

options.text: One bottle will not hurt
options.outcome: Your reactions are slow. You misjudge a turn and crash.

options.text: Only if I eat first
options.outcome: Food does not undo alcohol. You drift wide on a corner.

name: Roundabout
setup: A roundabout at Kibuye. Cars are already circling.
rule: In Uganda we drive on the left. At a roundabout, give way to traffic already in it, coming from your right, and go clockwise.

options.text: Slow down and give way to traffic from your right
options.outcome: You spot a gap and join without stopping anyone.

options.text: Enter fast. You have momentum
options.outcome: A car already in the circle hits your side.

options.text: Cut across the middle the short way
options.outcome: You ride against traffic in the circle. A bus horn is the last thing you hear before you fall.

name: Level crossing
setup: A railway level crossing. The lights are flashing and the bell is ringing.
rule: Always stop at a level crossing when the lights flash. Never try to beat a train.

options.text: Stop well back and wait until it has passed
options.outcome: The train thunders by. You cross when the lights stop.

options.text: Dash across before the train
options.outcome: The train clips your bike. You survive, barely.

options.text: Squeeze round the barrier
options.outcome: You slip through, but the train is closer than it looked.

name: Slippery road
setup: Heavy rain on the Masaka road. A SLIPPERY ROAD sign.
rule: In rain, ride slower, keep more distance, and brake early and gently.

options.text: Slow down and brake gently
options.outcome: Your tyres grip. You arrive wet but safe.

options.text: Keep your speed. Your fare is late
options.outcome: Your rear wheel slides out on a corner.

options.text: Brake hard at the bend
options.outcome: Your wheels lock and you go down.

name: Speed bump
setup: A speed bump sign near the market.
rule: Slow down for speed bumps and cross them straight. Hitting one fast can throw you and your passenger.

options.text: Slow down and cross straight
options.outcome: You glide over. Your passenger says nothing, which is good.

options.text: Fly over it
options.outcome: Your passenger is thrown up and you lose control.

options.text: Swerve onto the pavement to avoid it
options.outcome: You scatter market shoppers and a woman falls.

name: Lights and visibility
setup: It is 6:40 pm and getting dark.
rule: Wear a bright jacket and use your headlight when it is dim or dark, so others can see you.

options.text: Switch on your headlight and wear your reflector jacket
options.outcome: Drivers see you early and give you space.

options.text: Save fuel. Ride without lights
options.outcome: A car does not see you until it is too late.

options.text: Turn the light on, but take off the jacket. It is hot
options.outcome: Half-visible is still invisible. A driver misjudges your speed.

name: Turning right
setup: You need to turn right across traffic at Buganda Road.
rule: Check behind, signal early, and turn only when the way is clear. Never make a U-turn in the middle of the road.

options.text: Check behind, signal, then turn when it is clear
options.outcome: You turn smoothly and nobody honks.

options.text: Cut across. A matatu is far behind
options.outcome: It was not far enough. It hits you in the turn.

options.text: Make a U-turn in the middle of the road
options.outcome: A car cannot stop in time.

name: Pavements
setup: The jam is total. The pavement is empty.
rule: Pavements are for pedestrians. Stay on the road, even in a jam.

options.text: Stay on the road and wait
options.outcome: It takes ten minutes. Nobody is hurt.

options.text: Ride on the pavement. Just this once
options.outcome: A woman steps out of a shop and you knock her down.

options.text: Ride the pavement slowly, hooting
options.outcome: Slow or not, it is still the pedestrians' space. You are fined.

name: Road works
setup: Road works ahead. A flagman waves a red flag.
rule: Slow down at road works, obey the flagman, and watch for loose gravel and trenches.

options.text: Slow down and follow the flagman
options.outcome: He waves you through the safe line.

options.text: Ignore him and go
options.outcome: You hit loose gravel at the edge of a trench.

options.text: Overtake the queue along the raw edge
options.outcome: The edge crumbles and you fall.

name: Animals on the road
setup: Rural road near Mbarara. A cattle sign, and a herd on the road.
rule: Slow down for animals and wait. They will not move for a horn.

options.text: Slow down and wait for the herd to clear
options.outcome: The herd ambles off. You ride on.

options.text: Hoot and push through
options.outcome: The herd panics and a cow knocks your bike over.

options.text: Speed up before they cross
options.outcome: A calf steps out and you hit it.

name: Passenger seating
setup: Your passenger, in a long skirt, wants to sit sideways.
rule: Passengers must sit astride, facing forward. Loose clothing can catch in the wheel.

options.text: Ask her to sit astride and tuck her skirt in
options.outcome: She adjusts. The ride is steady and safe.

options.text: Let her sit sideways. It is comfortable for her
options.outcome: She slips off at the first bump.

options.text: Let her sit sideways, but ride slowly
options.outcome: Even at low speed, her skirt catches your wheel.

name: Loads
setup: A trader at Nakasero market wants you to carry four bunches of matooke and her too.
rule: Never carry a load wider than your handlebars or one that blocks your view or balance. Make two trips or send the load by car.

options.text: Take her and one bunch. Send the rest by pick-up
options.outcome: The bike stays steady and she gets the rest delivered.

options.text: Tie all four bunches on the sides
options.outcome: The bike sways at the first turn and you scrape a taxi.

options.text: Let her hold two bunches on her lap
options.outcome: She cannot hold on. At a bump she leans and you both fall.

name: Children on the bike
setup: A mother asks you to sit her small son on the fuel tank in front of you.
rule: Never carry a child on the fuel tank in front of you. A child must sit behind an adult, held securely, with a helmet that fits, or travel another way.

options.text: Ask the mother to hold him behind you, with a child helmet
options.outcome: You ride slowly. Both arrive safely.

options.text: Sit him on the tank. It is only a short ride
options.outcome: You brake hard for a matatu and the boy hits the handlebars.

options.text: Let him stand on the footrest
options.outcome: He slips at a pothole. You stop just in time, but police saw it.

name: Flooded road
setup: After heavy rain the road at Bwaise is under brown water. You cannot see the bottom.
rule: Do not ride into water when you cannot see the road. It can hide deep potholes and open drains, and fast water can sweep a bike away.

options.text: Turn back and take the higher road
options.outcome: It takes longer. Later you hear a car was stuck in that water.

options.text: Ride through fast to keep momentum
options.outcome: Your front wheel drops into a hidden drain.

options.text: Follow the taxi through slowly
options.outcome: The taxi is taller than you. Your engine floods and stalls mid-water.

name: Safe at night
setup: It is late. A man asks for a ride to a dark, empty road outside town and offers double.
rule: Your safety comes first. At night, share your trip details with your stage, stick to lit routes, and you may refuse a ride that does not feel safe.

options.text: Say no politely, or ride only with your stage knowing where you go
options.outcome: You lose the fare but get home safe.

options.text: Take it quietly. Double pay is double pay
options.outcome: On the empty road he tries to take your bike. You escape, but you are hurt.

options.text: Take it, but switch your phone off to save battery
options.outcome: Nobody can reach you when the bike breaks down in the dark.

name: Papers
setup: A traffic officer at a checkpoint asks for your riding permit and the bike's papers.
rule: Carry your riding permit and the bike's registration whenever you ride. Riding without them is an offence.

options.text: Show your permit and the bike papers
options.outcome: The officer checks them and waves you on.

options.text: Say you left them at home
options.outcome: The bike is impounded until you bring them.

options.text: Offer him something small to let you go
options.outcome: Bribery is a crime. You are arrested.
